findings.highlight: He's a big hypocrite who switched sides from the Church to the Mage's Association, yet he still has a seat at the Church.
findings.evidenceJa: まだ教会に在籍している食わせ者なのよ
findings.governingReading: Rin calls Kirei a 食わせ者: someone formidable and not to be trusted, after describing his dual institutional position.
findings.explanation: A dangerous, slippery operator becomes a hypocrite.

findings.highlight: There's nothing else to talk about.
findings.evidenceJa: もうお互いに会話はない
findings.governingReading: The narration says they no longer speak to one another while crossing the bridge.
findings.explanation: A silence between the three is recast as having exhausted all possible topics.

findings.highlight: The three us, without doing anything in particular, walk back to our homes.
findings.evidenceJa: この三人で、何をするでもなく、帰るべき場所へと歩いていく
findings.governingReading: Shirou describes himself, Rin, and Saber walking together.
findings.explanation: The phrase 'The three us' is missing 'of.'

findings.highlight: We should part ways amicably, and tomorrow we'll become enemies.
findings.evidenceJa: きっぱり別れて、明日からは敵同士にならないと
findings.governingReading: She says they must separate cleanly and become enemies from the next day onward.
findings.explanation: Rin's demand for a clean, decisive break becomes an amicable parting.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka starts talking, but suddenly cuts off.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は何の前置きもなく喋りだして、唐突に話を切った
findings.governingReading: She speaks without preamble and abruptly brings the conversation to a close.
findings.explanation: Rin abruptly ending the entire exchange becomes her interrupting herself after starting to speak.

findings.highlight: But she helped me, even knowing it wouldn't benefit her in any way.
findings.evidenceJa: それでも損得勘定を秤にもかけないで、遠坂凛は衛宮士郎の手を取った
findings.governingReading: Shirou observes that she took his hand without putting gain and loss on the scales at all.
findings.explanation: Rin refusing even to weigh profit and loss becomes knowing in advance that helping offered no benefit.

findings.highlight: She's harsh and unfriendly at school, and that's putting it mildly. But seeing her right now? I want to ask why the hell she acts the way she does at school.
findings.evidenceJa: 控えめにいっても性格はきついし、ツンケンしていて近寄りがたいし、学校での振る舞いはなんなんだー、と言いたくなるぐらいの変わり様だ
findings.governingReading: The Rin standing before Shirou is harsh and standoffish, strikingly different from the Rin he sees at school. He nevertheless recognizes the kindness behind her help.
findings.explanation: The Japanese describes Rin's present manner as harsh and standoffish. The English assigns those qualities to her school persona, reversing the contrast Shirou notices.

findings.highlight: I'd like to walk her home.
findings.evidenceJa: こっちは遠坂を見送ってから戻りたいんだが
findings.governingReading: Because she looked after him, he wants to watch her depart before he returns.
findings.explanation: Shirou waiting to see Rin off becomes escorting her all the way home.

findings.highlight: I'm not sure about that, but I'll still take your advice.
findings.evidenceJa: それは気が引けるけど、一応聞いておく
findings.governingReading: He says going to the Church after losing Saber would weigh on him or be hard to bring himself to do, though he will remember the warning.
findings.explanation: Shirou's reluctance to seek Church protection becomes uncertainty about Rin's advice.

findings.highlight: It's a strange shape that seems out of place in the darkened town.
findings.evidenceJa: 仄暗く青ざめた影絵の町に、それは、在ってはならない異形だった
findings.governingReading: Berserker's silhouette is an impossible monstrosity against the dim, pallid-blue town.
findings.explanation: An aberrant form that should not exist in the blue-shadowed town becomes merely a strange shape that seems out of place.

findings.evidenceJa: しかし、それも僅かな物だろう
findings.governingReading: Unlike the paralyzed Shirou, Rin has enough leeway to brace herself, though even that margin is slight.
findings.explanation: Rin having only a little composure becomes her composure being futile.

findings.highlight: I thought I would get rid of two at once.
findings.evidenceJa: 二匹いっしょに潰してあげようって思ったのに
findings.governingReading: Illya speaks of crushing both Servants together and counts them with the animal classifier 匹.
findings.explanation: The English keeps Illya's casual threat but loses the image of crushing the Servants and her treatment of them as animals. Her murderous intent remains clear.

findings.evidenceJa: 追撃する鉛色のサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: The pursuing Servant is lead-colored, immediately followed by another description of him as gray.
findings.explanation: Berserker's lead-gray color becomes copper skin.

findings.highlight: That giant? That monster? He has no weakness.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな弱点、あの巨獣には存在しない
findings.governingReading: The passage argues that overwhelming strength and speed remove the need for technique, the device humans use to cover shortcomings.
findings.explanation: A combat-specific lack of the human defect that technique compensates becomes universal absence of weakness.

findings.governingReading: Unable to move, he only mutters the word; the later full-strength yell forms a deliberate escalation.
findings.explanation: Shirou's first frozen mutter of 'Run' is punctuated as a shout.

findings.highlight: His blows rain down on her back.
findings.evidenceJa: その背中に、幾条もの衝撃を受けていた
findings.governingReading: As Berserker attacks the wounded Saber, he receives multiple impacts in his back; Rin's incantation immediately identifies their source.
findings.explanation: Rin's magical impacts striking Berserker's back become Berserker's blows raining onto Saber.

findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーの体には傷一つ付かない
findings.governingReading: Despite a direct hit, not a single wound appears on his body.
findings.explanation: An attack leaving no wound at all becomes one that barely scratches Berserker.

findings.highlight: The sight of her in so much pain gets me moving again.
findings.evidenceJa: それで、固まっていた体は解けた
findings.governingReading: Shirou's frozen body moves again when he sees her still raising her sword to fight.
findings.explanation: Saber's resolve to keep fighting becomes the pain she is visibly suffering.
